notes: This release packages the LLM-operated framework refactor: Python executes mechanical steps while the host LLM/Agent owns syllabus outline, concept writing, visual decisions, and final product review.
This is not a new final-ready handbook sample certification. Existing sample evidence remains scoped to its recorded release manifest.
Exact SVG is allowed only when svg_fit is exact and the asset is reviewed or approved; complex visuals remain external infographic jobs until reviewed raster assets are imported.

commands: python -m pytest tests/test_concept_jobs.py tests/test_guide_plan_llm_integration.py tests/test_visual_manifest_v2.py tests/test_validation_checks.py tests/test_quality_inspector.py tests/test_final_review_packet.py tests/test_core_contracts.py tests/test_handbook_project_manager.py tests/test_infographics.py tests/test_rendering_contracts.py -q

release_changes.python_role: mechanical execution only: source download, page-text extraction, JSON receipt/validation, rendering, PDF export, packaging
release_changes.llm_role: syllabus boundaries, exam points, concept explanations, worked examples, visual needs, quality inspection, final review
release_changes.visual_policy: svg_fit must be exact and reviewed/approved for SVG delivery; non-exact SVG and legacy deterministic-svg output are blocked from final delivery
release_changes.complex_visuals: external infographic jobs until callable generation/import and review are available

entries.scope_warning: Candidate framework evidence only. Do not generalize this manifest into certified subject output quality.
